blurb: Water Sort is a simple yet addictive puzzle game where you sort colored water in tubes until each tube contains only one color.
description:
Water Sort is a simple yet addictive puzzle game where you sort colored water in tubes until each tube contains only one color.

How to play:
- Tap a tube to pick up the top color, then tap another tube to pour it.
- You can only pour the same color on top of another same color.
- Sort all the tubes to win.

Why you'll love it:

🚫 NO ADS, EVER
No banners. No interstitials. No rewarded videos. Just pure, uninterrupted gameplay.

📊 ZERO TRACKERS
No analytics. No data collection. No tracking of any kind. Your gameplay is yours alone.

♾️ INFINITE LEVELS
Procedurally generated puzzles mean there's always a new challenge. No level caps, no energy bars, no waiting.

🔒 COMPLETELY OFFLINE
No internet permission required. Your data never leaves your device. Play anywhere, anytime.

🎨 CLEAN DESIGN
Minimalist interface with smooth animations and a calming color palette. Designed to relax, not to distract.

Start sorting today. Your brain will thank you.
